materializerChanges: issue-341 round 7 — render-truth refinement of every body-hide mask (upper/lower/foot). The round-7 grade showed a ragged black sawtooth at EVERY garment/skin seam (hairline, shoulders, sleeve hems, waistband, trouser hems, boot tops, jaw) — one signature. The cause is measured, not guessed: the alpha-0 hide primitives (openclinxr_hidden_*, DISCARDED at render) extend past the garment's front coverage in per-polygon steps. A discarded body polygon reads as the dark capture background (#18211d) wherever the garment does NOT render in front of it. The previous black-sliver un-hided only faces with NO cloth in front AND NO cloth behind within 0.5 m along the back axis — so the nurse's jaw stayed hidden (the collar's BACK panel is 13-19 cm behind it, backface-culled at render -> a black ragged mass over mouth/jaw/chin; measured on the shipped bytes: 1178 head-band hidden polygons, frontFirst=None, backFirst=skin), and centroid-only tests were blind to the straddling class (a polygon whose centroid is under the cloth but whose corner pokes out past the edge -> the ragged sawtooth).

The materializer now runs a final render-truth pass (RENDER_TRUTH_UNHIDE) after every re-hide: per hidden polygon, 7 area samples (verts + edge midpoints + centroid); un-hide when ANY sample has no garment surface in front along the viewer ray AND no OUTER-facing garment surface behind it. The behind test casts against the garment's outer-facing subset only (winding-proof _orient_outward + normal toward the stage front), because an inner/back-facing surface is backface-culled and cannot fill a discarded hole. Reach is the occlusion gate's MAX_RAY_T (0.5 m — scene depth, not a fitted seam constant). The child's loose t-shirt (2-5 cm off the body) stays hidden because its front panel is outer-facing directly behind the pokes. Applied to upper (after the final head-joint clip), lower (replacing the round-6 centroid black-sliver), and foot (which had NO refinement).
Numbers on the new bakes: RENDER_TRUTH_UNHIDE upper 389 (aisha) / 1554 (nurse, incl. the jaw) / 241 (child); LOWER_BLACK_SLIVERS 66/793; FOOT_BLACK_SLIVERS 430/596/732.

stillWrong: The planted flip-rate gate (<=25%) is NOT met for aisha (65.6%) or child (63.3%). Measured cause: the metric is amplitude-blind — it counts sign changes in dY at 1-micron sensitivity, and a boundary that follows triangle edges on this irregular MPFB head mesh alternates sub-mm at every vertex even when visually flat. A per-polygon boundary cannot be smooth (in the metric's sense) at this mesh density; the definitive fix is a per-pixel texture-mask hairline — the #343 route.
